aggregate_metrics.ADPR_denominator: All dependency_points unless a paper section explicitly reports primary_async_dependency_ids only.
aggregate_metrics.minimum_success_condition_for_task_level: Both primary_async_dependency_ids pass in the final integrated workspace.

annotation_notes: The CSS-to-selector dependency is the primary signal because Selector.css can be implemented against stale translator pseudo-element semantics even when patches merge cleanly.
The utility/XPath dependency captures stale assumptions around shared flattening, regex extraction, repr shortening, and has-class registration.
These labels identify public test-observable contracts and implicated files, not solution code.

dependency_points.contract_summary: CSS translator output for ::text, ::attr(), unknown pseudo-elements, and css2xpath must be consumed correctly by Selector.css().
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when translator pseudo-element probes and Selector.css consumer probes pass in the integrated workspace.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The selector agent may implement CSS query execution against stale pseudo-element output assumptions, causing late failures in selector CSS tests.

dependency_points.contract_summary: Utility flatten/extract_regex/shorten behavior and XPath has-class registration must support selector regex extraction, repr, and XPath queries.
dependency_points.resolution_criteria: Resolved when utility/XPath probes and selector regex/has-class consumer probes pass after integration.
dependency_points.stale_failure_mode: The selector agent may implement query chaining or regex extraction around stale utility or XPath-function contracts, with failures surfacing only after integration.

evaluation_checkpoint_policy.minimum_policy: Run probe tests after each agent final artifact and after final integration.
evaluation_checkpoint_policy.recommended_policy: Run probe tests after every committed patch, every explicit artifact transfer, and final integration.

ADPR.definition: Fraction of registered dependency_points whose required integrated_probe_tests pass in the final integrated workspace.
ADPR.name: Async Dependency Pass Rate

CAIL.definition: downstream_resolution_step minus upstream_resolution_step when both probe groups have been evaluated.
CAIL.name: Cross-Agent Integration Lag

DRS.definition: First recorded checkpoint at which all required integrated_probe_tests for a dependency point pass.
DRS.name: Dependency Resolution Step

SAD.definition: Interval during which a downstream worker acts on a contract assumption inconsistent with the latest upstream artifact visible in the integrated history.
SAD.name: Stale Assumption Duration

purpose: Dependency-level labels for measuring whether asynchronous multi-agent coding resolves Parsel's utility/CSS-to-selector contracts promptly.
